front.title: John
front.theme: FROM DUST TO A WORK FINISHED

back.hook: The Son went down into the dust of death, and came up out of it.
paragraphs: John 17–21 opens with Jesus praying for you and ends with a fisherman restored beside a charcoal fire. Between them stand a cross, one word from it — It is finished — and an empty tomb.
Twelve weeks walk from the high priest's prayer to the garden morning, through the arrest, the denial, Pilate's judgment seat, and a risen Lord who says, Follow me.
